riscv_dbg_source: Same 10x fork of riscv-dbg as CVA6 (CVA6-fork/corev_apu/riscv-dbg), instantiated standalone with NrHarts=2 -- see multihart_sim/tb_top_multihart.sv
_presets_note: Preset fields from the RISC-V Debug Spec (xml/dm_registers.xml, access=Preset). Values are the DUT's DECLARED parameters -- dm_pkg localparams and the hartinfo_t literal -- not values observed from RTL output. Sourcing them from the design's own configuration is what makes the model-vs-RTL comparison a real check: it verifies the RTL implements the parameters it was configured with.
_sbaccess_note: RTL-002 / issue #147: dm_csrs.sv:618 hardwires sbaccess to the bus width and PR #4 dropped the spec reset constant. Declared here so the model predicts this DUT and the SBA logic is still exercised; the deviation is tracked, not absorbed.
_features_note: Optional features. Set one false and the model stops claiming the corresponding registers: nothing is predicted and nothing is compared. Use this to describe a DM that does not implement a feature.
_multihart_note: The only declared difference from cva6.json is the hart count and what follows from it. The DM is the same RTL; the harts behind it are dbg_dummy_hart, which implement the debug-ROM run-control handshake and nothing else -- no register file, so no abstract command can succeed here.
